## TextureEncode32BitRGB10A2_00509047 — FloatVertexColorToRGB10A2

**Summary:** Converts floating-point vertex colors to packed 32-bit RGB10A2 format: R/G/B=10 bits each (scale 512), A=2 bits (alpha doubled).

**Frame-path:** NOT_FOUND  
**Call frequency:** UNKNOWN (no static path from tick root)

| this | 0x1058 | R | — | Vertex count — number of vertices to process (loop bound) |
